item.title: Michael Jackson Songs Swarm Top Movie Songs Chart After ‘Michael’ Premiere
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. We're looking at the latest from Billboard's Top Movie Songs chart, powered by Tunefind. And the big news is the debut of the Michael Jackson biopic, "Michael", which has brought four of the King of Pop's classics back onto the chart.
[Short music transition]
Host: The chart is based on a combination of song and film data, as well as sales and streaming information. And it looks like "Michael" has made a strong impact, with four Jackson songs debuting on the April 2026 list. "Billie Jean" leads the pack at number 3, with 32.9 million chart-eligible streams and 4,000 downloads in the US.
[Short music clip from "Billie Jean"]
Host: It's followed by "Beat It" at number 5, "Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough" at number 7, and "Thriller" at number 10. But despite this strong showing, "Michael" wasn't enough to topple the current leader, "Golden" by HUNTR/X from the movie "KPop Demon Hunters". This song has been ruling the Top TV Songs chart since July 2025, with 65.1 million streams and 9,000 downloads in April 2026.
[Short music clip from "Golden"]
Host: The full chart also features music from "Project Hail Mary" and "Zootopia 2". You can check out the full list online. That's all for this week's music update. Thanks for tuning in.
[Outro music plays]
